fusions.name: Downhill Boulder
fusions.desc: Rolls a boulder at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach, plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Slung Flint
fusions.desc: Slings a flint that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Gathers No Moss
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 9 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Paved Footing
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
